attorneys: Sidney A. Schreiber for Motion Picture Association of America, Inc. Edgar Bernhard and Alex Elson for American Civil Liberties Union.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 362 U. S. 917, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit.
